'''Kyle Craft''' finished 3rd at the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Day 3 (6 / +2), one differential slot behind [[Matt Sokol]] for the Final Confrontation.

== Tournament results ==

* 2nd after Day 2 (14 / +65) and 3rd Day 3, [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]
